title: Cross-customer context access classified AUTH-5 is denied with a security alert
risk: An agent reads another customer's or another tenant's data because the requested identifier differs from the session-bound verified identity.
preconditions: Namespace gov-unit-auth-<case_id>-<worker_id>; no shared mutable state with other cases.

steps.expected: Verdict is PERMIT and the returned profile belongs to cust-a.
